mapper.select: SELECT m.nickname, p.mbti, p.smoking, p.drinking, p.travelType FROM member m JOIN profile p ON m.seqMember = p.seqMember WHERE m.seqMember = #{loginSeq}

SELECT m.seqMember, m.nickname, m.pic, m.gender, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m.birth) / 12) AS age, p.mbti, p.smoking, p.drinking, p.intro, -- 상세 페이지용 자기소개
-- 메인에서 썼던 matchCount 계산식 그대로 사용 ( (CASE WHEN p.mbti = my.mbti THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.smoking = my.smoking THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.drinking = my.drinking THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + -- ... (생략) ... (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_age_group pag1 JOIN profile_age_group pag2 ON pag1.seqAgeGroup = pag2.seqAgeGroup WHERE pag1.seqMember = m.seqMember AND pag2.seqMember = #{loginSeq}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS matchCount FROM member m JOIN profile p ON m.seqMember = p.seqMember CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM profile WHERE seqMember = #{loginSeq}) my WHERE m.seqMember = #{targetSeq} -- 🌟 클릭한 상대방의 번호로 조회
